name: 5.3.2.Verify Page redirections for New Harvester + Category Listing Page
fullName: 5.3.2.Verify Page redirections for New Harvester + Category Listing Page
description:
Verify that the New Harvester + Category listing page (Track) (tractor-combine-harvesters/track/) loads successfully and every in-page link (outside the shared header/footer nav) resolves without a 404 or 500 error, with correct trailing slashes on internal links.

Expected: The New Harvester + Category listing page (Track) should load successfully (HTTP 200) and every in-page link in scope should resolve to a valid destination — no broken (404) or server-error (500) links, and internal links should end with a trailing slash.
